retagged.reason: The cited page s.v.Стуаћ prints the form ("СТУАЋ, стуаћа, m. vide стухаћ") but no people or region term; it refers the reader to стухаћ, whose page gives the Herzegovina label ("По Херцеговини", sources/peoples.json row "Ерц., Ерцеговини, Херцеговини" -> Serbs). Added that page so the Serbs value rests on a printed term.

The form СТУАЋ is printed on s.v.Стуаћ (kept); that page has no people term, so the стухаћ page, which it cross-references and which prints "По Херцеговини" (peoples.json row Ерц., Ерцеговини, Херцеговини -> Serbs), was added to carry the people.

grade_rationale.text: Every surviving clause rests on one source, Karadžić's 1852 Serbian dictionary, under the headword стухаћ (стуаћ is only a cross-reference to it).
Karadžić records it for one region only, Herzegovina ("По Херцеговини приповиједају"), mapped to Serbs; a single folklore collector counts as one 19th-century compiler, so the grade is literary.
